newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Dec 12.

text.p: * Amrion Inc said it was engaged in substantive talks over a possible business combination. The company also said it expects to meet 1996 sales and earnings estimates. Amrion shares closed at 21-1/8 Wednesday.

* Witco Corp said it will restructure, resulting in about 1,800 job cuts over three years and a fourth quarter charge of about $421 million. It expects savings from the effort to eventually exceed $200 million annually.
Witco also said its fourth quarter operating income would be roughly flat versus year-ago levels. Shares closed at 31.
